dialogues.speaker: Wszebor
dialogues.text: That's right, just like what I'm doing now. You find a high vantage point, hide yourself, mark the enemy's position, and hold your breath...

dialogues.speaker: Wszebor
dialogues.text: ...I'm sorry, I'm talking to myself again, am I not? *Sigh* I used to be really good at this, you know.
